title: CuOS System Configuration Schema
description: Schema for configuring CuOS system parameters including networking, update sources, and image versions.

update_registry.description: URL of the registry used for system updates (e.g., https://update.example.com)

update_registry_proxy.description: URL of the registry proxy used for system updates

update_registry_user.description: Username for accessing the update registry

update_registry_password.description: Password for accessing the update registry

hostname.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) of the system

ip-address.description: Static IPv4 address (required if DHCP is false)

network-mask.description: IPv4 subnet mask (required if DHCP is false)

routes.description: Static routes for this interface. Can be a single object or an array of objects.

network-mask.description: Subnet mask for the destination. Accepts dotted-decimal (e.g. '255.255.255.0') or numeric prefix (e.g. 24).

gateway.description: Next-hop IPv4 address for the route

docker_net_space.description: CIDR notation for Docker container network space (e.g., '10.235.128.0/18')

docker_net_space_size.description: Subnet size for Docker container networks (CIDR suffix)

custom_ca_certs.description: Custom CA certificates to be trusted by the system

swap_size.description: Swap size in GB (will only be extended if enough disk space is available)

initial_image_version.description: Version of the initial application image

initial_image_digest.description: Digest of the initial image for integrity check (optional)

updater_image.description: Image used for updating the system

updater_image_digest.description: Digest of the updater image for integrity check (optional)

os_image_version.description: Version of the operating system image

os_image_digest.description: Digest of the OS image for integrity check (optional)

os_root_password.description: Root Password for the operating system: local login or SSH - hash or password

os_root_authorized_keys.description: SSH public keys accepted for root login, written to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys on every boot. Key-based login works even without 'os_root_password'; without either, the root account is locked

os_ssh_server.description: Activate SSH server for the operating system, on port 4222

console_expert_password.description: Password for the expert menu of the console interface

console_password.description: Password for the console interface - hash or password

product_name.description: Product name shown in the boot menu and the installer, and used as the first part of the built artefact's file name (default: 'CuOS', or 'CuOS IaC' when the init image is a cuos-iac image)

system_name.description: Name of this particular system, used as the second part of the built artefact's file name (default: the hostname, else the configuration file or directory name)

platform.description: Target platform to build for, selecting the '<platform>_image' key and falling back to 'os_image' (e.g. 'x86_64', 'rpi-arm64', 'rpi-arm32', 'orangepi-zero3', 'lxc'). Overridden by 'tool.sh --platform'; defaults to the build host's architecture

boot_layout.description: Disk layout and boot chain to build: 'mbr' for an MBR disk with a FAT boot partition (Raspberry Pi, Orange Pi), 'gpt' for a GPT disk with BIOS and UEFI GRUB (PC-style firmware). Only needed for a platform the build tool does not know. Overridden by 'tool.sh --layout'
